message.title: Magnora Data Center ASA: Invitation to third quarter 2026 presentation
message.body:
22.10.2026 13:00:08 CEST | Magnora Data Center ASA | Non-regulatory press
releases

Magnora Data Center ASA will release its third quarter 2026 report and
presentation on Friday 30 October, and hereby invites investors, analysts and
other stakeholders to a webcast presentation on the same day at 9:30 CET. 

Please use the following link to access the presentation: 
https://qcnl.tv/p/GH_QxmipVS2_ACohgZFgGw

The quarterly report will be made available through a stock exchange
notification and at www.magnoradc.com - https://www.magnoradc.com 

CONTACTS

 * Investor Relations, contact@magnoradc.com 

ABOUT MAGNORA DATA CENTER ASA

Magnora Data Center ASA is a developer of data center projects and owner of
selected data center operations, with presence in Northern Europe and Italy.

Established by Magnora ASA, the Company was spun off and listed separately in
June 2026, becoming the first pure-play data center share listed on a European
stock exchange. Magnora ASA owns 52% of the shares and provides management
services to Magnora Data Center, which then benefits from Magnora's development
track record and extensive network of industrial and financial partners.

The Group has a strong balance sheet, enabling it to secure strategic positions
and finance the development of projects through key milestones towards
investment decisions.

Magnora Data Center ASA is listed on Euronext Growth Oslo under the ticker
symbol MDATA.
